name: CloudStrike Running Shoe
description: Lightweight women's running shoe with responsive cushioning and breathable mesh upper. Designed for race day performance with energy-return foam and a sleek aerodynamic profile. Perfect for competitive runners training for half-marathons and 10Ks.

name: AeroGlide Performance Runner
description: Men's performance running shoe with Boost midsole technology for maximum energy return. Engineered mesh upper provides breathability and support during long runs. Ideal for daily training and tempo workouts.

name: FlexMotion Trail Runner
description: Versatile trail running shoe with aggressive lugs for grip on technical terrain. Lightweight construction with protective rock plate and cushioned midsole. Built for mountain trails, mud, and steep descents.

name: PureStep Everyday Trainer
description: Women's everyday training shoe with CloudTec cushioning for a soft landing and explosive takeoff. Minimalist design transitions seamlessly from gym to street. Breathable upper with supportive heel counter.

name: VelocityMax Racing Flat
description: Ultra-lightweight racing flat designed for speed on race day. Carbon fiber plate and nitrogen-infused foam deliver explosive propulsion. Low-profile design minimizes drag for competitive runners chasing PRs.

name: HexGrip Pro Dumbbell 25lb
description: Professional-grade hex dumbbell with contoured chrome handle and rubber-coated heads. Anti-roll hex design keeps weights stable on racks and gym floors. Essential for strength training, bodybuilding, and home gym setups.

name: Classic Iron Dumbbell Set
description: Heavy-duty cast iron dumbbell set with knurled handles for secure grip during intense workouts. Classic design trusted by powerlifters and CrossFit athletes. Perfect for compound movements and progressive overload training.

name: PowerLift Rubber Dumbbell 30lb
description: Rubber-encased dumbbell with ergonomic handle designed for comfortable grip during high-rep sets. Floor-friendly coating protects surfaces and reduces noise. Ideal for home gyms, circuit training, and functional fitness.

name: HexCore Training Dumbbell 40lb
description: Heavy hex dumbbell built for serious strength athletes. Precision-machined weight ensures accuracy within 2% of stated weight. Textured grip reduces slipping during heavy bench presses, rows, and overhead movements.

name: ProSpin Tour Racket
description: Tour-level tennis racket with extended sweet spot and spin-enhancing string pattern. Head-light balance provides fast handling at the net. Used by club players and competitive tournament athletes seeking precision and power.

name: AceStrike Competition Racket
description: Competition-grade racket with Graphene 360 technology for enhanced stability and power transfer. Open string pattern generates heavy topspin on groundstrokes. Excellent choice for intermediate to advanced players.

name: PowerDrive 300 Racket
description: Power-oriented racket with oversized head for maximum forgiveness and easy power generation. Vibration-filtering technology reduces arm fatigue during long matches. Great for recreational players and beginners moving up.

name: NetMaster Pro Racket
description: Premium racket with countervail technology for reduced vibration and fatigue. Dense 18x20 string pattern provides exceptional control for flat hitters. The choice of precision-oriented competitive players.

name: AeroShield Road Helmet
description: Aerodynamic road cycling helmet with MIPS rotational protection system. Wind tunnel-tested design reduces drag while 21 vents provide excellent airflow. Lightweight at 250g with secure Roc Loc fit system.

name: VentFlow Pro Cycling Helmet
description: High-performance cycling helmet with unibody shell construction and EPS liner for superior impact protection. Optimized ventilation channels keep you cool on long climbs. Reflective details for low-light visibility.

name: UrbanRide Commuter Helmet
description: Urban commuter helmet with SPIN padding for rotational impact protection. Integrated rear LED light and NFC chip for emergency identification. Stylish design that looks great both on and off the bike.

name: TrailGuard MTB Helmet
description: Mountain bike helmet with extended rear coverage and removable visor. MIPS protection system and Float Fit retention for secure fit on rough terrain. Designed for trail riding, enduro, and downhill adventures.

name: StrikeForce Pro Boxing Gloves 12oz
description: Professional boxing gloves with premium leather construction and multi-layer foam padding. Secure hook-and-loop wrist closure provides stability during heavy bag work and sparring. The gold standard for combat training.

name: FitBox Training Gloves 10oz
description: Versatile training gloves perfect for boxing fitness classes and heavy bag work. Triple-density foam absorbs impact while synthetic leather ensures durability. Mesh palm ventilation keeps hands cool and dry.

name: TitanGrip Sparring Gloves 14oz
description: Sparring gloves with extra padding for safe training with partners. Full grain leather construction lasts through thousands of rounds. Anatomical hand compartment and long cuff provide wrist support and proper fist alignment.

name: EliteStrike Premium Gloves 16oz
description: Premium 16oz boxing gloves with advanced shock-absorbing foam and genuine leather shell. Extra padding protects both your hands and sparring partners. Professional-grade lace-up closure with optional hook-and-loop conversion.

name: PureFlow Insulated Sport Bottle
description: Double-wall vacuum insulated water bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. BPA-free construction with powder coat finish for easy grip. Essential hydration companion for gym sessions, runs, and outdoor adventures.

name: CrystalClear Sport Water Bottle
description: Classic wide-mouth water bottle made from durable Tritan plastic. Measurement markings help track daily water intake. Leak-proof lid and wide opening make it easy to clean and add ice cubes.

name: TrailSip Outdoor Water Bottle
description: Self-sealing bite valve for one-handed hydration on the trail. Magnetic cap keeps valve clean during outdoor activities. Lightweight and dishwasher safe, perfect for hiking, cycling, and camping.

name: ZenGrip Premium Yoga Mat
description: Premium yoga mat with dense cushioning and superior grip surface. Closed-cell construction prevents sweat absorption and bacteria buildup. Lifetime guarantee — this is the last yoga mat you will ever buy.

name: FlowForm Studio Yoga Mat
description: Studio-quality yoga mat with unique alignment guide system etched into the surface. Natural rubber base provides exceptional grip even in hot yoga classes. Eco-friendly construction with no harmful chemicals.

name: EcoFlex Travel Yoga Mat
description: Lightweight travel yoga mat that folds to fit in a carry-on. Non-slip surface works on any floor type. Affordable entry point for beginners or convenient second mat for travel and outdoor yoga sessions.

name: DeepRelief Textured Foam Roller
description: Multi-density foam roller with textured surface that replicates a therapist's hands. Targets tight muscles, knots, and trigger points for faster recovery. Essential post-workout tool for runners, lifters, and athletes.

name: ProRoll Muscle Recovery Roller
description: Professional-grade foam roller with smooth surface for gentle myofascial release. Medium density suitable for beginners and post-workout recovery. Physical therapist-recommended for IT band, back, and leg muscle relief.

name: FlexZone Density Foam Roller Set
description: Three-density foam roller set for progressive muscle release — soft, medium, and firm. Color-coded for easy identification. Covers every recovery need from gentle warm-up rolling to deep tissue work.

name: SummitPack 40L Daypack
description: Versatile 40L daypack with ventilated back panel and adjustable torso length. Multiple compartments including hydration sleeve and trekking pole attachments. Perfect for day hikes, gym commutes, and weekend travel.

name: UrbanFit Gym Backpack
description: Water-resistant gym backpack with separate shoe compartment and ventilated pocket for sweaty gear. Padded laptop sleeve fits 15-inch devices. Designed for athletes who train before or after work.

name: AlpineTrail Technical Pack
description: Technical hiking pack with FlexVent suspension and breathable back panel. Integrated rain cover and multiple external attachment points for gear. Built for alpine adventures and multi-day backcountry trips.

name: SpeedView Sport Sunglasses
description: Sport performance sunglasses with Prizm lens technology for enhanced color and contrast. Lightweight O-Matter frame won't slip during runs or rides. 100% UV protection with impact-resistant plutonite lenses.

name: TrailShade Polarized Sunglasses
description: Polarized sunglasses that eliminate glare from water, snow, and pavement. Classic style works for trail and street. Scratch-resistant glass lenses with full UV400 protection for all-day outdoor wear.

name: AeroLens Performance Sunglasses
description: Elite performance sunglasses with photochromic lenses that adapt to changing light conditions. Wraparound coverage blocks wind and peripheral light. Unobtainium nose pads increase grip with sweat for secure fit during intense activity.

name: PitLane Racing Helmet
description: Full-face racing helmet with Snell SA2020 certification for professional motorsport use. Peripheral vision enhancing visor opening with anti-fog shield. Fireproof interior lining rated for open-wheel and touring car competition.

name: GridStart Full-Face Racing Helmet
description: Premium full-face helmet for go-kart and formula racing. Multi-layer EPS liner absorbs impacts at varying velocities. HANS-ready M6 terminal posts for professional harness systems.

name: ApexDrive Competition Helmet
description: Competition-grade auto racing helmet with forced-air ventilation system. Lightweight composite shell construction reduces neck fatigue during endurance races. Tear-off visor posts for quick shield changes during pit stops.

name: ClassicRide Leather Saddle
description: Handcrafted leather jumping saddle with deep seat and forward-cut flap for secure leg position. Premium calfskin leather molds to rider and horse over time. Wool-flocked panels ensure even weight distribution.

name: ProStride Riding Stirrups
description: Stainless steel stirrups with wide footbed and rubber tread for secure grip. Safety release mechanism prevents foot entrapment during falls. Offset eye design promotes proper leg alignment in the saddle.

name: Heritage Dressage Saddle
description: Classical dressage saddle with deep seat and long, straight flap for optimal leg position. Double-layered leather construction with French calfskin seat. Adjustable gullet system fits a wide range of horse conformations.

name: CastMaster Pro Fishing Rod
description: Medium-action spinning rod with graphite blank for sensitivity and durability. Cork handle provides comfortable grip during all-day fishing sessions. Fuji guides reduce line friction for longer, smoother casts.

name: RiverRunner Spinning Rod & Reel Combo
description: Ready-to-fish spinning combo with matched rod and reel. Smooth 5-bearing reel system handles everything from panfish to bass. Great starter setup for casual anglers and weekend fishing trips.

name: ProLeap Dog Agility Hurdle Set
description: Competition-grade dog agility hurdle set with adjustable bar heights. Lightweight aluminum construction for easy transport to training grounds and tournaments. Includes six hurdles with high-visibility poles for outdoor and indoor courses.

name: K9 Sport GPS Tracker Collar
description: Waterproof GPS tracker and activity monitor designed for active dogs. Tracks distance, calories, and rest patterns alongside your training runs. Real-time location sharing and geofence alerts keep your adventure buddy safe on trails.
